title: "Our packages"
toc: false

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(cranlogs)
library(gh)

n_downloads <- cranlogs::cran_downloads(
  packages = c("palaeoverse", "sepkoski", "rphylopic", "rmacrostrat"),
  from = "2015-01-01",
  to = Sys.Date()
)
n_downloads <- n_downloads[, c("count", "package")]
n_downloads <- tapply(n_downloads$count, n_downloads$package, sum)
nms <- names(n_downloads)
n_downloads <- round(n_downloads, digits = 1)
n_downloads <- paste0(round(n_downloads, digits = -3) / 1000, "k+")
names(n_downloads) <- nms

stars_palaeoverse <- gh(
  "GET /repos/palaeoverse/palaeoverse/stargazers",
  .accept = "application/vnd.github.star+json",
  .limit = Inf
)
stars_sepkoski <- gh(
  "GET /repos/LewisAJones/sepkoski/stargazers",
  .accept = "application/vnd.github.star+json",
  .limit = Inf
)
stars_rphylopic <- gh(
  "GET /repos/palaeoverse/rphylopic/stargazers",
  .accept = "application/vnd.github.star+json",
  .limit = Inf
)
stars_rmacrostrat <- gh(
  "GET /repos/palaeoverse/rmacrostrat/stargazers",
  .accept = "application/vnd.github.star+json",
  .limit = Inf
)

stars <- c(
  length(stars_palaeoverse),
  length(stars_sepkoski),
  length(stars_rphylopic),
  length(stars_rmacrostrat)
)
names(stars) <- c("palaeoverse", "sepkoski", "rphylopic", "rmacrostrat")
```
